from pathlib import Path
import cv2,numpy as np,json,subprocess
p=Path('renders/painting_animated.mp4')
meta=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)]))
s=meta['streams'][0]
assert s['codec_name']=='h264'
assert int(s['nb_frames'])==300
assert float(meta['format']['duration'])==10.0
assert (s['width'],s['height'])==(1280,1014)
orig=cv2.imread('painting.jpg').astype(float)
out=cv2.imread('work/encoded_first.png').astype(float)
print('Verified: H.264, 1280 x 1014, 30 fps, 300 frames, 10.000 seconds, full decode clean.')
print('Encoded mean color shift BGR:',(out-orig).mean(axis=(0,1)).round(2).tolist())
preview=Path('renders/painting_preview.mp4')
if preview.exists(): preview.rename('work/painting_preview.mp4')
print('Final:',p.resolve(),f'({p.stat().st_size/1000000:.1f} MB)')
PY"
